integrity: The collision probability is derived exactly from background autocorrelations and completed to a strict quadratic in the Bernoulli product. The two-coin phase boundaries follow algebraically from projection onto the exact feasible product interval. Exact-rational computation replays the identities but is not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The general theorem varies two Bernoulli parameters at fixed pair sum rather than solving the full fixed-total-mean optimization over every coordinate.
The closed quadratic identity is specific to order-two Rényi entropy.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent collision identity under older convolution terminology.
title: Exact fixed-sum phase diagram for collision entropy of Bernoulli sums
